explanation: pKaH values: ethylamine 10.8 (sp³, lone pair free), aniline 4.6 (lone pair diluted into ring), pyrrole -3.8 (lone pair in aromatic system; protonating destroys aromaticity), acetamide -0.5 (lone pair delocalized into C=O; protonation goes on O not N). Alkyl amines > aryl > amides ≈ pyrrole.
